amendment: Observability test — scope of the information set, and the status of a history-based successor

admissibility.evidence: the 21-cell C5 discovery scan was still in its first wave when this was written; artifacts/c5_discovery/C5_RESULT.json did not exist
admissibility.what_this_changes: records the scope of the frozen information set and pre-authorizes ONE narrowly-bounded successor test
admissibility.what_this_does_not_change: the selector class, the 28 legal_context fields, the baseline, the 0.50 recovery bar, the evaluation block, the statistics, or any outcome condition

the_scope_being_recorded.what_the_frozen_selector_sees: legal_context at a SINGLE TIMESTEP -- 28 scalar fields describing the field at the moment of decision
the_scope_being_recorded.what_it_does_not_see: any history, prefix, or temporal aggregate of the episode so far
the_scope_being_recorded.why_this_matters: opponent regime is plausibly far easier to infer from a PREFIX of observed behaviour than from one frame. A router deployed with recurrent or stacked-frame input would have strictly more information than this selector.
the_scope_being_recorded.consequence_for_a_negative: an UNROUTABLE verdict means 'not recoverable from a single legal frame at the 0.50 bar'. It does NOT mean 'not routable'. The frozen reporting language must say single-timestep explicitly.

history_based_successor.status: PRE-AUTHORIZED IN FORM, NOT IN CONTENT
history_based_successor.why_declared_now: declaring it after an UNROUTABLE result would be indistinguishable from scrambling for a second attempt at a gate that just failed. Declared before any number exists, it is a scoped follow-up rather than a re-roll.
permitted_only_under_all_of: its own preregistration, frozen before any of its data exists
its own fresh unspent seed block, never 9860000
a history representation fixed in advance, not searched
the SAME 0.50 recovery bar and the same baseline definition
opponent identity still excluded from the selector
explicitly_does_not: authorize a search over history lengths or encodings until one clears the bar
history_based_successor.reporting_rule: if both tests run, BOTH verdicts are reported. A history-based pass alongside a single-timestep failure is a finding about the observation space -- routable only with memory -- not a retroactive pass of the frozen test.

frozen_reporting_language.UNROUTABLE: The confirmed opponent-conditional tradeoff was not recoverable from a single-timestep legal_context observation at the 0.50 recovery bar.
frozen_reporting_language.ROUTABLE: A legal single-timestep observer recovered at least half the oracle-selector gain on an unspent block.
what_neither_claim_extends_to: task-outcome value, since the utility is a carrier_survival screen proxy
any statement about what a recurrent or history-conditioned router could achieve
opponents outside the admitted OP6-OP12 mixture

immutability: After any observability number exists, none of the above may change.
